notes.title: Update Unknowz - 1.0.2
notes.notes: [h1]Thank you for playing Unknowz![/h1][h3] Here’s what’s new in this update:[/h3][list][*][p]Added explosion sound when kamikaze enemies die.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed an element that allowed players to skip the final shark puzzle without solving it.[/p][/*][*][p]Added audio feedback during the shark sequence.[/p][/*][*][p]The shark now resumes chasing players if you reload a game in the middle of its level.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy damage is now displayed when they are hit.[/p][/*][*][p]General game optimization (textures, ticking actors, shadows, lights). Game size reduced by 300MB and stability improved.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826300/Unknowz/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
